A.claim: For Azon signature (r,r,p), Hypothesis 5 holds iff AB has a prime factor q not dividing 2r with ord*(q mod r) even. Moreover EVERY (r,r,p)-reduction of the all-even Beal branch arising from the Pythagorean parametrisation has AB = 1 or a power of 2, so Hypothesis 5 fails for all of them and Azon level lowering is structurally inapplicable to that b
